644: ### The base-change of a linear map of `R`-modules to a linear map of `A`-modules
645: -/
646: 
647: 
648: section Semiring
649: 
650: variable {R A B M N P : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
651: variable [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B]
652: variable [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P]
653: variable [Module R M] [Module R N] [Module R P]

656: variable (A) in
657: /-- `baseChange A f` for `f : M →ₗ[R] N` is the `A`-linear map `A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N`.
658: 
659: This "base change" operation is also known as "extension of scalars". -/
660: def baseChange (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N :=
661:   AlgebraTensorModule.map (LinearMap.id : A →ₗ[A] A) f
662: 
663: @[simp]
664: theorem baseChange_tmul (a : A) (x : M) : f.baseChange A (a ⊗ₜ x) = a ⊗ₜ f x :=
665:   rfl
666: 
667: theorem baseChange_eq_ltensor : (f.baseChange A : A ⊗ M → A ⊗ N) = f.lTensor A :=
668:   rfl
669: 
670: @[simp]
671: theorem baseChange_add : (f + g).baseChange A = f.baseChange A + g.baseChange A := by
672:   ext
673:   simp [baseChange_eq_ltensor, -baseChange_tmul]
674: 
675: @[simp]
676: theorem baseChange_zero : baseChange A (0 : M →ₗ[R] N) = 0 := by
677:   ext
678:   simp
679: 
680: @[simp]
681: theorem baseChange_smul : (r • f).baseChange A = r • f.baseChange A := by
682:   ext
683:   simp
684: 
685: @[simp]
686: lemma baseChange_id : (.id : M →ₗ[R] M).baseChange A = .id := by
687:   ext; simp
688: 
689: lemma baseChange_comp (g : N →ₗ[R] P) :
690:     (g ∘ₗ f).baseChange A = g.baseChange A ∘ₗ f.baseChange A := by
691:   ext; simp
692: 
693: open AlgebraTensorModule in
694: lemma baseChange_baseChange {A B : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
695:     [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower R A B]
696:     (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
697:     ((f.baseChange A).baseChange B) =
698:     (cancelBaseChange R A B B N).symm ∘ₗ
699:       (f.baseChange B) ∘ₗ (cancelBaseChange R A B B M) := by
700:   ext; simp
701: 
702: variable (R M) in
703: @[simp]
704: lemma baseChange_one : (1 : Module.End R M).baseChange A = 1 := baseChange_id
705: 
706: lemma baseChange_mul (f g : Module.End R M) :
707:     (f * g).baseChange A = f.baseChange A * g.baseChange A := by
708:   ext; simp
709: 
710: variable (R A M N)
711: 
712: /-- `baseChange` as a linear map.
713: 
714: When `M = N`, this is true more strongly as `Module.End.baseChangeHom`. -/
715: @[simps]
716: def baseChangeHom : (M →ₗ[R] N) →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N where
717:   toFun := baseChange A
718:   map_add' := baseChange_add
719:   map_smul' := baseChange_smul
720: 
721: /-- `baseChange` as an `AlgHom`. -/
722: @[simps!]
723: def _root_.Module.End.baseChangeHom : Module.End R M →ₐ[R] Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M) :=
724:   .ofLinearMap (LinearMap.baseChangeHom _ _ _ _) (baseChange_one _ _) baseChange_mul
725: 
726: lemma baseChange_pow (f : Module.End R M) (n : ℕ) :
727:     (f ^ n).baseChange A = f.baseChange A ^ n :=
728:   map_pow (Module.End.baseChangeHom _ _ _) f n

731: def _root_.LinearEquiv.baseChange (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : A ⊗[R] M ≃ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N :=
732:   AlgebraTensorModule.congr (.refl _ _) e

arguments.statement: ∀ (A : LR.Actions M x y h) (b₀ b : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) K (LR.VK K M)), LR.ReducedMatrices K l M x y h A b₀ → LR.ReducedMatrices K l M x y h A b → ∃ C : Module.End K (LR.VK K M) ≃ₐ[K] Module.End K (LR.VK K M), C (LR.induced K M A.lx.map) = LR.induced K M A.lx.map ∧ C (LR.induced K M A.ly.map) = LR.induced K M A.ly.map ∧ ∀ i j, C (LR.unit l b₀ i j) = LR.unit l b i j
arguments.proof:
intro A b₀ b h₀ hb
let e := b₀.equiv b (Equiv.refl _)
have he (i) : e (b₀ i) = b i := by simp [e]
have hes (i) : e.symm (b i) = b₀ i := by rw [← he, e.symm_apply_apply]
let C := e.conjAlgEquiv (R := K)
refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· apply b.ext
  intro i
  change e (LR.induced K M A.lx.map (e.symm (b i))) = _
  rw [hes]
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · have hi' : i = 0 := Fin.ext hi
    subst i
    rw [h₀.1, hb.1, map_zero]
  · let j : Fin (l+1) := ⟨i.val-1, by omega⟩
    have hj : j.val+1 = i.val := by dsimp [j]; omega
    rw [h₀.2.1 i j hj, hb.2.1 i j hj, map_smul, he]
· apply b.ext
  intro i
  change e (LR.induced K M A.ly.map (e.symm (b i))) = _
  rw [hes]
  by_cases hi : i.val = l
  · have hi' : i = ⟨l, Nat.lt_succ_self l⟩ := Fin.ext hi
    subst i
    rw [h₀.2.2.2.1, hb.2.2.2.1, map_zero]
  · let j : Fin (l+1) := ⟨i.val+1, by omega⟩
    have hj : j.val = i.val+1 := rfl
    rw [h₀.2.2.1 i j hj, hb.2.2.1 i j hj, map_smul, he]
· intro i j
  apply b.ext
  intro k
  change e (LR.unit l b₀ i j (e.symm (b k))) = _
  rw [hes]
